Subject: Co-sell demo: staggered region micro-schedule & ops sync

Hi Samir / Nicola —

Thanks again for agreeing to the joint marketplace demo with Acme. Given the cross-region audience (APAC, EU, US) and the SI run-through requirements, I want to propose a staggered schedule so we can:

- Hit prime hours in each region,
- Keep the technical run-through for the SI separate from the customer-facing demo, and
- Reduce risk by having a short warm-up window before each regional session.

Proposed slots (all durations are 60 minute demos + 15 minute buffer):
- APAC: 2027-07-08 09:00–10:15 SGT (preferred)
- EU:   2027-07-08 14:00–15:15 BST
- US:   2027-07-08 17:00–18:15 PDT

Attached is a lightweight runbook (staggered-demo-runbook-v1.pdf) and an .ics with candidate windows (timezone-grid.ics). Can you confirm: 1) which slots you can staff, 2) whether the SI needs a 30m pre-brief before each region, and 3) any conflicts on your side?

If those exact times don't work we can pick alternate windows on 7/9 or 7/12.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Ben / Marissa —

Heads-up from ops: if we're running 3 region windows back-to-back with 30m SI pre-briefs, we should plan staffing so the presenter team has short handoffs and one engineer stays on standby for rollback. Proposed internal plan:

- Lead presenter: Ben (all regions)
- SI-facing tech lead (pre-brief): Marissa (will do APAC & EU pre-briefs)
- Standby infra engineer: Karthik (will cover US window + escalation)
- Prep tasks: 1) Verify Avocado (SSO) demo account, 2) Confirm KV cache replay for longer sequences, 3) Upload fallback model variant in runbook section 3.

I'll update the runbook and mark internal tasks as assigned. Confirm and I'll send calendar invites for internal dry-run on 7/7 10:00–10:45 PDT.
